notes: Equivalent Weights Chart: tons per point for supplies moved by naval convoy, interport transfer, railroad or air; tons per replacement point and per truck/motorisation point by method; stacking-point equivalents for rail and interport moves

Air-lifted replacement points (2 tons each, note *) may only be infantry-class. Interport truck points at 50 tons (note †) and the rail truck-point stacking figure (note ‡) apply only to unattached truck points, or attached ones beyond the parent unit's total TOE Strength Points
Fuel is 1/8 ton per point, consistent with 49.11's 250 pounds; ammunition 4 (50.1) and stores 1 (51.15) also match the text
Unresolved: the last stacking row, 'Unit of Stacking Points 1/2', is transcribed as printed; its meaning is ruling R-070
